datasets.title: Sierra Leone - Settlement catchment areas
datasets.description: This dataset shows settlement-based catchment areas in Sierra Leone with information on total population disaggregated by sex and age and number of buildings.. [Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX); Original dataset: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/sierra-leone-settlement-catchment-areas]

lineage.description: Settlement catchment areas were generated by identifying population clusters from gridded population data, assigning representative points to each cluster, and using Voronoi tessellation or similar spatial algorithms to delineate catchment boundaries. Population counts from multiple sources (WorldPop, GRID3, Kontur, Meta) were disaggregated by sex and age groups within each catchment. Building counts were derived from OpenStreetMap and Google satellite-based detection at varying confidence levels, with average footprint areas calculated for structural characterization.
